title: A week of every bus and tram in Paris
description:
A week of every bus and tram in Paris, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Paris city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Bus, Tram and Night bus.

Busiest moment: 992 vehicles, Friday at 6:45 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable. October 24 and October 25 are left out because the clocks change. Île-de-France Mobilités starts its October timetable on October 9, so the earlier days are left out. Île-de-France Mobilités changed its timetables during October and has fewer than three usable October Sundays, so its Friday and Sunday each use one typical date.
